label: pipeline

method.clock: DWT CYCCNT, each trial independently checked against its GPIO pulse
method.included: complete public transactions, validation, callbacks and precomputed-draw copying
method.excluded: init/restoration/output validation/GPIO marker writes; counter-read overhead retained
method.memory: persistent arrays + descriptor + public reusable workspace + PF outputs; not stack/peak RAM
method.gpio_tolerance: 1 microsecond + 2% of DWT time; every pulse below one DWT wrap
method.layout: 256 KiB Flash / 96 KiB SRAM; 8 KiB reserved stack, not a measured high-water mark

fpu_modes.f32: hard ABI, CP10/11 enabled, hardware single precision
fpu_modes.f64: hard ABI, CP10/11 enabled, software double arithmetic
fpu_modes.q15: soft ABI, CP10/11 disabled, no linked VFP instructions
fpu_modes.q31: soft ABI, CP10/11 disabled, no linked VFP instructions

method.noise_matrices: This workload uses diagonal Q and R; correlated factors retain the floating pivoted solve.
